'''Custodia Pass''' is a trail in the [[Custodia Mountains]] allowing travel between [[Auburnvale]] and the [[Kebos Lowlands]]. The pass is briefly visited during the [[Shadows of Custodia]] quest.

The pass contains the entrances to the [[Stalker Den]], a dungeon where [[custodian stalker]]s are found.

==Points of interest==
*[[Dead tree]]
*[[Rod Fishing spot (lure, bait)|Rod fishing spots]]
*Entrances to the [[Stalker Den]]

==Inhabitants==
*[[Alpaca]] and their [[Alpaca cria|cria]]
*[[Bear cub]] (level 15)
*[[Giant bat]] (level 27)
*[[Grizzly bear]] (level 21)
*[[Harpy eagle]]
*[[Lynx]] (level 21)
*[[Rabbit]] (level 2)
*[[Stag]] (level 15)
*[[Viceroy butterfly]]
